description: This Java class defines the MonkeyKeyEvent, a subtype of MonkeyEvent, used for simulating key events in the Android Monkey testing tool. It encapsulates key event details and manages their injection into the system.

classes.name: MonkeyKeyEvent
classes.description: Represents a keyboard event for the Android Monkey testing framework, capable of simulating key presses and injecting them into the system.

methods.name: getKeyCode
methods.description: Returns the key code associated with this event.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action type (e.g., key down or key up) for this event.

methods.name: getDownTime
methods.description: Returns the down time of the key event.

methods.name: getEventTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the event.

methods.name: setDownTime
methods.description: Sets the down time for the key event.

methods.name: setEventTime
methods.description: Sets the event time for the key event.

methods.name: isThrottlable
methods.description: Indicates whether the event can be throttled, typically if it is an ACTION_UP event.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Injects the key event into the Android input system through the window manager and activity manager.
